No REDDIT_CLIENT_ID exists anywhere in the repo, so no request this system can make will succeed. The endpoint fix in 9bc2849 (old.reddit + raw_json=1) was correct code against a door that is shut. Reviving this source requires a registered OAuth app and oauth.reddit.com — not a code change here.

Key catalysts include ongoing discussions around urban warfare and geopolitical conflicts, which may influence investor sentiment towards technology stocks. Additionally, the FOMC meeting on October 28th is a significant event that could shift market dynamics, prompting traders to reduce size and widen stops into the window of uncertainty. The volume profile indicates an accumulation zone with key levels at 7853.44 for ES and 31231.28 for NQ, suggesting potential support areas. Given the current concentration regime, we should be cautious about trusting directional moves and watch for a reversal when AI-related stocks cool off. The bias is towards long-the-dip with a probability of ~65%, invalidated below 30,375.
